categories.label: Coaching, transfers & depth
categories.summary: Depth, replacement quality, transfer impact and coaching continuity are collected broadly but only influence canonical projections when their feature treatment has been validated and promoted.

items.title: Role over raw counts
items.detail: Starter and replacement roles matter more than a simple injury count. Conflicting or stale reports remain unresolved rather than being forced into a point value.

items.title: No manual points
items.detail: Unvalidated injury, coaching or roster news never receives an invented discretionary spread adjustment.

categories.label: Situational trends
categories.summary: Trends, rivalry angles, rest narratives and other situational signals remain hypotheses until they demonstrate incremental leakage-safe predictive value.

items.title: No trend shopping
items.detail: Post-hoc patterns and betting trends are contextual evidence, not automatic model features or picks.

items.title: Prospective evidence first
items.detail: A new feature must survive historical testing, walk-forward validation and prospective frozen-week evidence before explicit promotion review.
